_about: Public-domain William Gadsby (1773-1844), Strict Baptist minister of St George's Road, Manchester, for the Word Hoard: The Nazarene's Songs (1824), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 50 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_excluded.gadsby-other: The Gospel Standard magazine (1835, many hands); A Memoir of the late Mr. William Gadsby (1844, by others)
